title: Bridge
text: “Way to go, bro! Becoming king is awesome, and as for that jerk of a brother and king… oh, sorry.”
Keel apologized, being considerate of his Finacée. She gave a wry smile, telling him not to worry about it.
“Lord Iwatani, you’re scheduled to make a triumphant return to the people shortly, so please don’t stay too long.”
“Ah, yes… Um, do Melty and I really have to get engaged after all?”

His future father-in-law glances back and forth between the queen and the representatives of Siltvelt. His finacée’s cheeks are flushing slightly. Is this infidelity? What’s going on here, even though he has someone named Filo-tan?
“Lord Iwatani, thanks to your steadfast efforts, Melromarc is severing the chains of its past grudges and is on the verge of being reborn as a nation where humans and Demi-Humans can live together.”
“That’s right. Through this conflict, Siltvelt has also reflected on its own folly and will surely be able to build friendly relations with Melromarc.”
“Exactly. Thank you so much for stopping the foolish invasion we were on the verge of committing.”
My father is responding to the Queen and the representative from Siltvelt with a slightly embarrassed look.

“No… I just wanted to say that responding to a global crisis takes priority over doing something as pointless as war… And the fact that we’ve made it this far is thanks to Motoyasu, Melty, Keel… I’ll stop here since naming everyone would take too long, but it’s all thanks to all of you.”

Oh… what an honor to hear those words. Hearing that from my Father as he sits on the throne makes him seem even more majestic than usual. It seems Kiel, my Finacée, Yuki, Kou, Sakura, and Luna are all delighted as well—perhaps they share my sentiment.
As for the Lazy Pig… well, never mind him. He’s probably just thinking, “Oink, oink—I’ve jumped on the winning horse.”

“That’s fine. We’ve forced the Heroes to fight against their will. Battling the Waves is what the Heroes are truly meant to do. Yet we’ve dragged them into this foolish conflict—I have nothing but words of apology.”
“Mother…”

My Finacée is gazing at the Queen with mixed feelings. The future Finacée and her Father share—what would you call it?—a strange bond of trust. They’ve always been the kind of relationship where they speak openly and honestly.

It seems as though the Finacée is being a bit deferential toward her Father. Or rather, the way she looks at him is different. It’s as if… she harbors a faint romantic feeling for him. However, I’ll say this to the Finacée outright.
“Finacée”
“…What?”
Furrowing his brow, the Finacée looks my way. Why does he have such a bad impression of me? Well, from my perspective, he’s my fated rival for Filo-tan, so bring it on!
“Even though you have a Finacée named Filo-tan, I won’t stand for an engagement with my Father. You should be ashamed of yourself!”
“That’s why I don’t know anything about that girl!”
“Motoyasu-kun, don’t bring up that topic too much. Because of the loop’s effects, there’s a time gap—Melty-chan wouldn’t have any way of knowing about a girl she’s never even met.”
Oh? My Father gently scolded me. Eventually, my father turned his gaze back to the Queen and the representative from Siltvelt.
“We’ll just keep it at the surface level—that she has a connection to Melty-chan. Otherwise, it wouldn’t set a good example for the people, or something like that.”
When my father asked the Queen, she tilted her head in thought.

“No, as far as we’re concerned, the engagement between Lord Iwatani and my daughter, Melty, is an indispensable matter for the future of Melromarc. Even if Lord Iwatani were to complete his mission and return to his original world, Melty must bear Lord Iwatani’s child—otherwise, we’ll be in trouble.”
“Of course, she must also bear children with the people of our country, Siltvelt…”
“Exactly.”
“Yes. The peace Lord Iwatani desires… a bridge connecting Melromarc and Siltvelt. For the sake of both nations, I humbly ask for your cooperation.”
“Ugh…”

Having intervened on behalf of both Melromarc and Siltvelt, it seems my Father can’t argue back. But for him to be the one connecting these two nations… that’s truly impressive! As his slave and subordinate, I’m truly proud of him.
“Oink.”
It seems that Lazy Pig has wrapped things up. My Father slumped in defeat, desperately trying to get through the moment.
“Mel-chan, are you okay?”
“Yes, I’m sorry, Sakura-chan.”
“For what?”
My Finacée’s cheeks turned red as Sakura-chan showed her concern.
“I wonder… what we should do now.”
“That’s it! Lars-chan, thank you so much for helping us in this battle! It really saved us that you and your group were there!”

My Father was shaking the panda beastman’s hand up and down repeatedly, as if trying to save face. The panda beastman, however, was looking away from my Father with an exasperated expression. What’s he unhappy about?
“As for the reward… yeah. I absolutely promise! In fact, I want you to fight alongside me from now on!”
“Whoa! So I can fight alongside someone other than that cool sister and Siltvelt!?”
Keel steps in here, wagging his tail happily.
“That’s right! The battles against the waves are going to get tougher from now on, so the more hands, the better!”
“Don’t just decide that on your own!”
“If I remember right, you said we could rebuild the village and gather everyone together, right, big bro!?”
“That’s true… but I’m a bit hesitant to make the people from Keel’s hometown fight…”
“What are you talking about! Everyone’s definitely going to want to get stronger! I’ll convince them, so don’t worry! Woof woof.”
Keel barks excitedly, “Woof woof.”
“Well… it looks like there’ll be plenty of money involved.”
“‘Boss! This is our chance to make it big!’”

The panda beastman’s subordinates seem pretty excited, too. It’s true—going from a mere mercenary to a member of the Hero’s party is a huge step up. Plus, since it’s a personal recruitment offer from Father himself, Siltvelt can’t very well complain.
“Alright. But I’m not cheap, you know.”
“Don’t worry! You can rest easy on that front. Money’s not an issue. You can dress up in all the cute outfits you like, Lars-chan, and we’ll have some fun in between battles.”
“Wait—what are you saying in a place like this?!”
The panda beastman scolds her father, fuming with anger, but he’s just grinning from ear to ear.
“You’re beautiful even in your Demi-Human form, and you’re adorable as a Panda—I think Lars-chan is way more attractive than everyone realizes.”
“Th-that’s exactly why! Don’t drop bombshells like that in a place like this!”
At Father’s compliment, the Siltvelt crew’s eyes lit up, and the panda beastman’s hackles rose.
“If you look closely, she comes from a rare lineage… She might be trying to seduce the God of Shields to improve her status.”
“No, no—it seems she’s highly trusted, and given her performance in this battle, isn’t she worthy of being a Siltvelt warrior?”
“…Very well. Serve the Shield Hero to your heart’s content.”
“N-no! I’m a free mercenary—”
“‘Damn it! Our boss is going to be stolen away by that guy! B-but we can’t beat his track record!’”
“You lot, shut up too!”
That’s when her Assistant and Rival muttered something like that.
“The Shield Hero has it rough, doesn’t he?”
“Exactly! I want Gaelion to marry Naofumi, too.”
“Huh?”
“Boo!”
Sakura-chan, looking annoyed, tried to outdo her rival by hugging her father from behind.
“S-Sakura-chan?”
“Father, you must be happy that everyone has such high hopes for your achievements.”
“Motoyasu-kun, this isn’t what we agreed on. You need to realize that the outcome is different from what you said it would be!”
After that, my father kept glaring at me, looking completely bewildered.

My father left the castle to make a triumphant return to the people, parading around the town of Melromarc. Eventually, he waved to the people from the castle terrace, and as the sun set, a grand party was held at the castle. On this occasion, all the heroes, including my father, declared that they would go into training in conjunction with the revitalization of Cal Mira Island.

The long battle had finally come to an end. Although traces of the conflict were still visible throughout the castle, everyone seemed to be enjoying the festivities in their own way. Before the loop, I had gotten so angry at the renaming of the Crimson Swine during this celebration that I even challenged my Father to a duel, but this time, there were no such disruptions. Everyone was happily enjoying the festival without a hitch.
